name: Clockwork Guardian (The Tower Vault Heist)
body:
CLOCKWORK GUARDIAN
CR 4

This ogre-sized figure crafted from metal stands absolutely stationary, with only a steady hum giving away the presence of clockwork within. One hand is shaped into a fist, while the other is is formed from a serrated circular blade.

XP 1,200
N Large construct
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 14, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 natural, +2 dodge, -1 size)
hp 57 (4d10+30)
Fort +3, Ref +7, Will +3
Immune construct traits
Weaknesses vulnerable to electricity

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee 1 slam +8 (2d6+4)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 14, Con -, Int -, Wis 10, Cha 2
Base Atk +4; CMB +4, CMD 16
Feats Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Clockwork Wind-up (Ex)

As per Clockwork Guardian (Normal.

Spinning Saw-blade (Ex)

As per Clockwork Guardian – Normal but Melee +8 dealing 3d6+3 slashing damage.
